assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

The TUI's /new on 2.x is a new session at the same location; the record maps it to a new API session followed by archiving the old one (reset_session). The new session is admitted on its first activity with a new ses_… id (watcher_v2.go, P3) and binds to the service pid. The old one is archived, so the reader reports it gone (v2SessionGone → transcript_removed) and the detector flips it to ready; it is then not the newest root on the shared pid, and OwnsSharedPID answers false for an archived row (pid.go), so the same-pid dedupe removes it on a later sweep (pid_manager dedupeByPIDPeriodic).

## Spec choices

- Turn 1 on session 1; the reset's archive is a transcript_removed on session 1.
- A NEW ses_… session is born after it, and the next prompt drives working → Stop hook → ready on that new session.
caveats: The new session is admitted on its first prompt, not at the reset itself: an API session with no activity is invisible to the reader (P3), so 'new session appears in ready' is its post-turn ready.

sources.note: 2.x reader: lists session_v2 rows with time_archived IS NULL; a session is admitted on its first session_message activity while a service is up (#2107); an archived or missing row emits EventRemoved (v2SessionGone)
servicePIDFor: a session no client runs binds to the one running service; OwnsSharedPID answers false for an archived row
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)

HandleProcessExit/HandleWatcherExit: every session bound to an exited pid gets process_exited and is deleted, children first; idlesOnHost lets the ready TTL reap an idle root on a live session host (opencode SessionHostArgv)

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
One turn on session 1, reset_session (a new session at the same location, then PATCH session 1 {archived: true}), then one turn on the new session
settings deny the shell tool in RUN_CWD/opencode.json (a backstop: the local model reached for it in a no-tool turn once)

script.text: Reply with exactly the word: ok. Do not use any tools.
Reply with exactly the word: fresh. Do not use any tools.

verify: session 1's turn ends in ready; the reset archives it (transcript_removed)
a NEW ses_… session runs the next turn working → ready
